facts.text: Topstep may, for no consideration and without notice, alter or cancel any Reward earned by a user it deems to have violated the Terms, 'regardless of if such activity was or was not related to earning such Reward'. No appeal mechanism stated.

Prohibited conduct includes conduct that 'in the sole discretion of Topstep, represents uncommercial activity, is intended to game the market, is not a viable trading strategy, or is not responsible trading'; consequence can be forfeiture of withdrawals from every other account.
Trading Rules 'remain subject to change at any time and from time to time, with or without notice'; terms changes effective upon notice in a form at Topstep's discretion.

Users who disparage Topstep, its competitors or affiliates can be barred from a Reward at Topstep's sole discretion; conduct risking reputational damage can lead to loss of access without compensation.
